name: Accordion
description: A stack of headings that each open a section. You can allow one section or several to be open at once.

name: Agent Glyph
description: The agent’s icon, used as its avatar next to messages and activity. It uses the theme’s primary colour.

name: Alert
description: An inline banner with a title and a description, in default, success, warning, and destructive variants.

name: Alert Dialog
description: A modal that asks you to confirm an important action. It closes only from its buttons or the Escape key.

name: Approval Card
description: Lets the agent check with you before it acts, with a question, a few options, and Confirm and Skip buttons.

name: Aspect Ratio
description: Keeps media at a fixed shape as its width changes.

name: Avatar
description: Shows a person as a photo or initials, alone or as an overlapping group.

name: Badge
description: A small label for state or category, in primary, secondary, outline, and destructive styles.

name: Breadcrumb
description: Shows where a page sits in the hierarchy, with a collapsed middle for long trails.

name: Button
description: Runs an action. Comes in six variants and four sizes, with icon, loading, and disabled states.

name: Button Group
description: Joins related buttons into one row with shared edges, including split buttons.

name: Calendar
description: A month grid for picking a single date or a range, with today marked and keyboard navigation.

name: Card
description: Groups related content on a raised surface. Whether it uses a border or a shadow comes from the theme’s separation setting.

name: Carousel
description: A row of slides with previous and next buttons, swipe, and arrow-key support.

name: Chart
description: Recharts charts with theme colours, gridlines, and tooltips. Series colours come from the chart tokens.

name: Checkbox
description: Turns an option on or off. It also has an indeterminate state for when only some items are selected.

name: Citations
description: Numbered markers in an answer that preview their source, and the list of sources underneath.

name: Code Block
description: Code with a filename header and a copy button, for agent output and docs.

name: Collapsible
description: A single trigger that shows or hides the content beneath it.

name: Combobox
description: A select with a search field. Type to narrow the options, then pick one.

name: Command
description: A searchable list of actions with groups and shortcuts. Use CommandDialog to open it as a palette.

name: Command Palette
description: Command in a modal that opens from a button or a keyboard shortcut. Type to filter, use the arrow keys to move, Enter to run, and Escape to close.

name: Confidence Bar
description: Shows how sure the agent is with a bar and a word (high, medium, or low), so colour isn’t the only cue.

name: Context Menu
description: A menu of actions that opens at the pointer when its area is right-clicked or long-pressed.

name: Copy Input
description: A read-only field with a copy button, for API keys, webhook URLs, and share links.

name: Data Table
description: A table with sorting, filtering, row selection, and pagination, built on TanStack Table.

name: Date Picker
description: A button that opens a Calendar and shows the chosen date in short form.

name: Dialog
description: A modal window over the page. Focus moves inside, Escape closes it and focus returns to the trigger.

name: Drawer
description: A bottom sheet with a drag handle, for mobile-first flows. Swipe down or press Escape to close.

name: Dropdown Menu
description: A menu of actions below a trigger, with icons, shortcuts, checkbox items, submenus, and a destructive style.

name: Empty
description: A placeholder for an empty view. It explains what goes there and offers one action to get started.

name: Field
description: Lays out the label, control, help text, and error for one form field, so your forms look consistent.

name: Hover Card
description: A floating preview that shows while the pointer is over its trigger, or while the trigger has focus.

name: Input
description: A single-line text field, with invalid and disabled states.

name: Input Group
description: A text field with a fixed prefix, suffix or icon inside one border.

name: Input OTP
description: One box per character for one-time codes. Focus moves to the next box as you type, and you can paste the whole code.

name: Item
description: A row with media, a title, a description and actions, for lists, settings, and search results.

name: Kbd
description: Shows a keyboard key or shortcut in a small keycap.

name: Label
description: A text label for a form control. Clicking it focuses the control it names.

name: Menubar
description: A row of menus like the menu bar in a desktop app. Once a menu is open, use the arrow keys or hover to move to the others.

name: Message
description: One turn in a conversation. User messages sit in a bubble on the right. Assistant messages are plain text with actions.

name: Native Select
description: The browser’s own select, styled to match the theme. Works best on mobile and for long lists of options.

name: Navigation Menu
description: Site navigation with dropdown panels of links, for marketing sites and docs.

name: Pagination
description: Moves through pages of results with numbered links, previous and next.

name: Popover
description: A floating panel anchored to a trigger, for short forms, settings, and details.

name: Progress
description: Shows how far a task with a known length has come.

name: Prompt Input
description: The message box for a chat, with a text field that grows as you type, tools, and a send button. Enter sends and Shift+Enter adds a line. While the agent works, send becomes stop.

name: Radio Group
description: A set of options where exactly one is selected. Arrow keys move the selection.

name: Resizable
description: Panels you can resize by dragging, or with the arrow keys when a handle has focus.

name: Scroll Area
description: A fixed-height container that scrolls its content with a thin, theme-coloured scrollbar.

name: Search Input
description: A search field with a shortcut hint, and a clear button once there is a value.

name: Select
description: A dropdown for picking one value from a short list, with groups and separators.

name: Separator
description: A hairline between groups of content, horizontal or vertical.

name: Sheet
description: A panel that slides in from any edge over a dimmed page. Useful for edit forms and detail views.

name: Sidebar
description: App navigation that collapses to icons on desktop and becomes a sheet on mobile. Press Ctrl+B or ⌘B to show or hide it.

name: Skeleton
description: Placeholder blocks that hold the shape of content while it loads.

name: Slider
description: Picks a number or a range by dragging. The arrow keys move it one step at a time.

name: Spinner
description: A spinning ring for work with no known length. Announced to screen readers as loading.

name: Stat
description: A labelled number with an optional change. Ups and downs show with an icon and text, not just colour.

name: Status Dot
description: A small coloured dot for presence and health, always paired with a text label.

name: Stepper
description: Progress through a fixed sequence of steps, with done, current, and upcoming states.

name: Streaming Text
description: Types out a response with a cursor, then hides the cursor. If reduced motion is on, it shows the whole text at once.

name: Switch
description: Turns a setting on or off immediately, without a save step.

name: Table
description: Composable table parts for simple tabular data. Use Data Table when you need sorting or selection.

name: Tabs
description: Switches between views in the same context. Arrow keys move between tabs.

name: Textarea
description: A multi-line text field that resizes vertically. Use it for messages, notes and descriptions.

name: Thinking Indicator
description: A short label with pulsing dots that shows while the agent works. Screen readers announce it without interrupting, and the dots stay still if reduced motion is on.

name: Thinking Steps
description: The steps an agent is working through, with done, active, and upcoming states.

name: Toast
description: Short, temporary messages in a stack. Mount one Toaster near the root and call toast() from anywhere.

name: Toggle
description: A button that stays pressed, for one on/off option such as a filter or formatting.

name: Toggle Group
description: A joined row of toggles for picking one option, or several, from a small set.

name: Tool Call
description: A tool the agent called, with its status and, on demand, its input and output.

name: Tooltip
description: A short label shown on hover or focus. Don’t put anything essential only in a tooltip.

name: Typography
description: Text styles from the theme’s type scale. Headings use the display font and body text uses the text font.
